rules.name: Compile Seedance production structure
rules.enforcement: Order prompt as header, continuity, reference roles, hard locks, START, timed action, camera, environment/light, dialogue/sound, END, and negative rules.

rules.name: Seedance timing follows duration
rules.enforcement: Support 30-second thirds when applicable without hardcoding 30 seconds as the only duration or forcing cuts.

rules.name: MiniMax cannot override project law
rules.enforcement: MiniMax receives only relevant structured context and may not redesign approved assets or invent permanent IDs.

rules.name: MiniMax returns schema-matching output
rules.enforcement: Require role, project law, continuity, references, sequence, START/MIDDLE/END, camera, audio, restrictions, and an explicit output contract.

rules.name: New model assets remain proposed
rules.enforcement: New recurring assets created during expansion are PROPOSED/DRAFT and require explicit approval before use.

rules.name: Connection settings stay outside film rules
rules.enforcement: Endpoint, model, authentication, timeout, context, and generation settings belong to provider adapters and may not alter film law.
